The figure consists of two subplots illustrating training reward trajectories over a series of steps, separated into an "Easy Training Set" (top) and a "Hard Training Set" (bottom). Both subplots share a linearly scaled x-axis labeled "Steps," ranging from 0 to 500 with tick marks provided at evenly spaced intervals of 100. Both subplots feature identically labeled y-axes, "Training Rewards," which are linearly scaled but have different value ranges and tick intervals; the top plot's y-axis ranges from 0.0 to approximately 0.45 with tick intervals of 0.2, while the bottom plot's y-axis ranges from 0.0 to approximately 0.22 with tick intervals of 0.1. Both subplots overlay their data onto a grid. 

The top plot, titled "Easy Training Set," displays two solid lines without markers, each enveloped by a lighter shaded variance band of the corresponding color. The dark teal line, labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Easy," starts at roughly 0.02 on the y-axis at 0 steps, climbs steadily to reach a localized peak near 0.36 around 230 steps, and then oscillates between 0.28 and 0.36, ultimately ending near 0.33 at 500 steps. The dark red line, labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Easy," initiates near 0.02 at 0 steps, sharply rises to roughly 0.22 by 80 steps, and maintains an oscillating upward trend, culminating at a value of approximately 0.40 at 500 steps, with its highest visible peak around 0.42 near 480 steps.

The bottom plot, titled "Hard Training Set," contains two solid lines without markers. The dark red line, labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Hard," features a lighter shaded variance band; it begins at roughly 0.01 on the y-axis at 0 steps, exhibits a persistent upward climb marked by regular oscillations, and finishes near 0.20 at 500 steps, reaching a maximum peak of approximately 0.21 around 490 steps. The dark teal line, associated with a legend label heavily obscured by a white overlay ending in the letter "d", starts near 0.03 at 0 steps, gradually declines to 0.0 by approximately 90 steps, and runs flat along the lowest grid line until the data trace abruptly terminates near 180 steps.
